notes:
Access: plain direct HTTPS fetch, no blocking at all (Magento 2 storefront). COUNTS: every qty is the Magento rendered header inside

(e.g. '1 - 40 of 106 Products'). Verified empirically two ways: (a) on all 29 single-page nodes the count of unique data-product-id tiles equals the header exactly; (b) all six multi-page nodes (Pendants 77, Table Lamps 106, Wall Lights 45, Bedside Lights 52, Wall Mirrors 90, Wall Art 41) were enumerated to exhaustion and the unique product-ID total matched the header exactly, with one page past the end returning zero tiles. No count was estimated or inherited. TRAP FOUND: this Magento silently serves the PARENT category when a slug does not exist rather than 404ing. Three mega-menu/CMS chip links do this - /lighting/bathroom-lights/, /home-furnishings/accessories/bathroom/ and /home-furnishings/accessories/picture-frames/ all render the parent listing (h1 'Lighting' 299, h1 'Accessories' 460). They are dead links, not categories, and were dropped; every kept row was confirmed by a matching h1. RULE 0 GAINS: Bathroom Mirrors (2) and the whole outdoor branch - Outdoor Wall Lights (12), Decorative Outdoor Lights (21), Outdoor Festoon Lights (7), Outdoor Garden Mirrors (1), Decorative Outdoors (5), Outdoor Plant Pots & Planters (4) - were all kept on product type despite room/location words. I also hunted for a bathroom-lighting node; the site advertises one in its lighting chip grid but the URL is a dead link (above), so it does not exist. Cox & Cox has no lighting-by-room tree; its 'Shop By Room' branch (Bedroom, Kitchen, Lounge, Dining, Bathroom, Hallway, Home Office, Utility) is a mixed all-product-type roll-up carrying furniture, textiles and storage alongside decor with no decor-specific children, so those roll-ups were dropped under the mixed-roll-up rule rather than any room rule. RULE 0.6 OVERLAPS DOCUMENTED (measured by product-ID set comparison, all kept): Decorative Mirrors 10/10 = 100% contained in Wall Mirrors; Round Mirrors 15/16 = 94% contained in Wall Mirrors; Outdoor Festoon Lights 6/7 = 86% inside Decorative Outdoor Lights; Decorative Trays & Bowls 14/21 = 67% shared with Trinket Boxes & Bowls; LED & Rechargeable 10/18 = 56% shared with Table Lamps. All are genuine distinct nodes in the site's own mega-menu, and Rule 0.3 names Decorative and Round mirrors as in scope, so they are kept and the containment is flagged here for the merge. FRAGRANCE CHECK: the only candle node is /accessories/candle-holders/ (23). I read all 23 titles - every one is a holder, lantern, candelabra or unscented LED pillar candle; zero scented candles, zero diffusers. Kept. Cox & Cox's fragrance range is not a nav category. EXCLUDED: Faux Plants & Flowers (faux botanicals); Bulbs & Cables (not fixtures); Fireside (23 - fire screens, fireside tool sets and log baskets: fireplace tools/utility); Hardware (54 - dominated by cabinet knobs, handles, towel rails and toilet-roll holders); Door Furniture; Doormats; Pet; Halloween and Gifts (holiday/gift); Paint and wallcoverings; Table Linen and all Soft Furnishings (textiles); Water Features (0 products, empty); Braziers & Firepits, Barbecues, Parasols, Outdoor Textiles, Plant Stands (functional garden); all Furniture, Seating, Tables, Beds, Storage furniture; Sale and New (marketing views). Shelves (16) and Hooks & Hook Racks (29) sit under the site's Storage branch but every product is a decorative wall shelf or decorative wall hook/hook rack, so they are kept on product type per the decorative-metal rule. Office Accessories is a real category with exactly 1 product (marble bookends, a decorative object) - thin but genuine.
